transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?
I’ve been feeling low for a long time—like, the last couple of years. Even when I’m at work, at church, or with people I care about, there’s this heavy, empty feeling that never really goes away.

Over these past two years, have there been specific stretches of time—say, two weeks or more—when this low, empty feeling became much more intense or disabling than it usually is, compared to the rest of the time?
It’s not really in separate stretches. It’s just been there all the time for the past couple of years—the same heavy, empty feeling, even when I’m working or at church or with people I care about.
Along with this ongoing low, empty feeling, have you also been experiencing a lot of anxiety or worry, or physical tension like a racing heart, restlessness, or being on edge?
I’m not really sure. I mostly just notice the low feeling. I haven’t paid much attention to whether I’m tense or on edge.
Besides the low, empty feeling, have you noticed changes in your appetite or sleep, low energy, trouble concentrating, low self-esteem, or feelings of hopelessness during this time?

My appetite’s been pretty off. Most days I’ll skip eating until near the end of my shift because nothing sounds good, and then sometimes I just get vending machine snacks late because I’m wiped out. My weight’s gone up and down enough that my work pants fit differently from month to month.
Have you noticed yourself worrying excessively about different things, or feeling physically tense—like tight muscles or restlessness—on most days during this time?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed worrying a lot or feeling physically tense most days.
During this same period, have you noticed changes in your sleep, such as trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah. I’m exhausted after being on the production floor all day, but then I get into bed and my mind just keeps going over everything I’m behind on. And even when I do fall asleep, I wake up feeling like I barely rested.
During this same time, have you noticed trouble concentrating or difficulty making decisions, even about everyday things?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear problem with concentrating or making everyday decisions.
During this same time, have you noticed feelings of low self-esteem, or a sense of hopelessness about things getting better?
Yeah… I’ve felt really low for the last couple of years. Even when I’m at work or church or with people I care about, there’s this heavy, empty feeling that just doesn’t really go away.
